## Two Step-0 findings about the tree itself

1. **Five of six `ground-truth.edn` carry CRLF in this working tree and
   LF in HEAD**, hidden by `.gitattributes:1`'s `text=auto eol=lf`. Every
   byte comparison in ADR-0149 is therefore against `git show HEAD:`, not
   the checkout. `make traces` rewrote them as LF, so the clone now
   agrees with HEAD.
2. **The seven `messages*.txt` end in three different byte shapes**
   (`\r`, `\r\r\n`, `\r\n\n`), so at most one could be a faithful
   `--format er7` capture. Recorded before the content census ran.

## Census: prediction vs actual

Prediction written to disk before the first command: persona-enriched
diverges, the other six are byte-identical. **Actual: wrong on six of
seven** -- five are content-identical but differ in trailing bytes, and
`module-mix` diverges substantively. Full table in ADR-0149.

## The one STOP condition, and how it resolved

`module-mix/messages.txt` was an "other"-class divergence, which the
fence makes a STOP. Probed before reporting: a disposable worktree at
`f07684c` -- the commit that last wrote the file -- running that README's
own command produces **today's bytes exactly** (16,851; determinism
re-checked with a second fresh run first). The engine has not moved this
trace, so the committed bytes were never its output. Two readings
collapsed to one; fix-forward with disclosure, not a STOP. The worktree
was removed with `git worktree remove --force` and pruned; tree clean
after.

### The red at `76b4e20`, and its fix

`poly test :all skip:integration` failed on ONE assertion:
`ehrt.cli.executable-bits-test/tracked-scripts-are-executable-in-the-index-test`
-- `bin/regen-traces` landed **mode `100644`** in the git index. The
later steps (`verify-nist-lock`, the generated-doc freshness diff) were
skipped, so CI has not yet exercised the `demos/traces/` diff this
session added; the next run is its first.

**Cause, and why local green did not catch it.** This clone has
`core.fileMode=false`, so git ignores the filesystem executable bit
entirely: `chmod +x bin/regen-traces` made the worktree file
`-rwxr-xr-x` and `git add` still recorded `100644`. That is precisely the
mismatch this gate exists to catch, and precisely why it reads the INDEX
rather than the working tree. The Step 2 verification ran
`clojure -M:poly test brick:docs-tooling`, which does not include
`bases/cli`, so the gate never ran locally before the push. **The lesson
is the verification's, not the gate's: a targeted brick run is not a
substitute for the full suite before a push, however narrow the change
looks.** This is the second instance of this exact class in two weeks --
`bin/state-migrate-0147` landed `100644` the same way (ADR-0147, session
record `2026-08-17-compression-d-state.md` S-7).

**Fixed forward with disclosure**, one defensible reading (a script that
must be executable is not executable), so no STOP -- the rule this
session landed, applied to its own defect:

    git update-index --chmod=+x bin/regen-traces

Swept rather than spot-fixed (`rulings.md#R-population-closure`): every
tracked file under `bin/` and `.githooks/` re-checked afterwards, and
`bin/regen-traces` was the only offender in either directory.

## Tag

The prompt's licence has two branches: pay in session if this session's
tip run concludes `success` while the session is open, else defer to the
next Step 0, saying which
(`rulings.md#R-session-verifies-ci-via-gh`, landed this session).

Which branch this took cannot be known until the close commit is pushed
and its own run concludes, so it is recorded in an addendum to
`notes/adr/0149-demos-traces-gated.md` rather than guessed here -- the
same shape ADR-0147 and ADR-0148 each used. The licensed tag is
`stable-20260817-demos-traces-gated`, and deferring it is the deviation
(`rulings.md#R-tag-law`), so the default is payment the moment the
condition is met.
